sentences.text: Ab The State Of West Bengal vs Rina Paul on 8 December, 2023

Author: Harish Tandon
Bench: Harish Tandon
233 08.12. Fat 4 of 2019
 2023 Ia No. Can 1 of 2022
 Ia No. Can 2 of 2023
 Ct. No. 04
 Ab The State of West Bengal
 Vs.
 Rina Paul.

Mr. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay, Mr. Aniruddha Sen.
... for the appellant.
Mr. Indranath Mukherjee, Mr. Pradip Kumar Neogi, Mr. Sakti Prasad Chakraborty, Mr. Asish Dutta.

Re: CAN 1 of 2022 This is an application for condonation of delay of 266 days in preferring the instant appeal assailing an order of the Land Acquisition Court enhancing the compensation to the respondent in relation to a land acquired under Act-I of 1894.
However, the Stamp Reporter has indicated that there is a delay of 197 days in preferring the instant appeal.
We do not want to go into the veracity of the length of delay, the moment the respondent candidly submits that she has no objection if the instant application is allowed.
In view of the above, the instant application is allowed on consent.
The delay in preferring the appeal is hereby condoned.
The office is directed to formally register the appeal.
Let the application for stay being CAN 2 of 2023 be listed on 11th December 2023.

(Harish Tandon, J.) (Madhuresh Prasad, J.)
